direct_input_review_method: Complete shared native initial input; each subsequent actual input change and new event; exact payloads directly at first acquisition, repeated payload equality verified; complete thinking/final/return and next host decision for all calls.
decision: Retain the repaired host and documented interface; ordinary evidence-to-action composition is demonstrated on this injected development task. Prepare a fresh investigation next, without another wording comparison or broad refactor.

observed_friction.interpretation: Two exact repeated src pages plus one redundant root confirmation; child/root information remained resident. Causal role of presentation is not isolated.

Thinking repeatedly treats or questions the accepted repair as the original incident; exact diff and source are resident, prior thinking is immediately omitted. Final actions recover. Whole response costs are not causal attribution.

observed_friction.item: Read applicability and repeated confirmation deliberation
observed_friction.interpretation: Some doubts resolve correctly before acting. L02-012 actually confirms changed source once; terminal responses decline repeated checks. These differ from absent-source recovery or duplicate navigation.

evidence_limits: One injected owner-controlled development task, two seeds, no treatment comparison or general performance estimate.
No actor ran the failing baseline before editing; source itself names a stale map and imports the needed builder.
Eight concrete public assertions passed; printed map/version agreement also true. No new hidden grader or donor-equality acceptance.
No context boundary, live historical retrieval, action rejection, failed-check correction or budget stop was exercised.
Private reasoning was omitted immediately; source/action/result evidence stayed resident. No pressure-loss or working-account efficacy claim.
Same executor used for separate offline replay; mechanical verification does not certify direct reading or independently implement tool semantics.
Observed maximum output and GPU margin do not qualify a future harder workload or justify a silent reserve change.
retained: Prospective return validation before state commit and exact recoverable originals.
Full source-checked tool forms/effects and accurate scoped navigation/resource wording.
Ordered activity, canonical recovery identity and candidate/file/check bindings.
Direct review of complete thinking and final responses with actual inputs/results and next decisions, including successes.

deferred.item: Exact host-generated grouping and object scopes
deferred.condition: Use exact records, not invented rationale or state. Assess consequence and subsequent use; prior generated errors do not disprove grouping.

deferred.item: Working account or other memory change
deferred.condition: Establish whether rationale omission, removed evidence or present evidence misuse is the relevant failure. No automatic mechanism from verbosity.
